req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /tasks/{task_id}. I design tests using: EP (valid id returns 200 with correct body), NEG (non-existent id returns 404 with detail message), BVA (boundary ids: id=1 lowest pre-loaded, id=20 highest pre-loaded, id=0 invalid/not-found, id=21 not-yet-created). Each test asserts exact status codes, exact field values from the pre-loaded dataset, and exact error detail strings to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants. Tests are self-contained, use TestClient in-process, and rely only on fields present in schemas.Task: id, title, description, completed, created_at, updated_at.

tests.name: test_get_task_by_valid_id_returns_200_with_correct_body
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists in the pre-loaded dataset
Task id=7 has title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
expected: Response body description == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
trace: R-TASK-008: system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_task_by_valid_id_returns_200_with_correct_body():
    r = client.get("/tasks/7")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 7
    assert body["title"] == "Fix login bug"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert body["description"] == "Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith."
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["created_at"] is not None

tests.name: test_get_task_after_create_returns_correct_id
preconditions: 20 pre-loaded tasks exist; next created task gets id=21
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a new task
expected: GET body id matches captured id (21)
GET body title matches created title
trace: R-TASK-008: state transition — task created then retrieved; catches mutation that returns wrong task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_task_after_create_returns_correct_id():
    payload = {"title": "STC test task", "description": "state transition", "completed": False}
    cr = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert cr.status_code == 201
    created = cr.json()
    new_id = created["id"]
    assert new_id == 21
    r = client.get(f"/tasks/{new_id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 21
    assert body["title"] == "STC test task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
